data.title: Jerboa - Qatar
data.subtitle: Eco-Friendly Padel Ball E-commerce
data.description: A premium e-commerce platform for sustainable padel balls, featuring a sleek minimalist design with scroll-driven animations and bilingual support.
data.full_description: Jerboa is an eco-conscious sports brand based in Doha, Qatar, offering high-performance padel balls in recyclable packaging. The platform combines striking visual design with smooth Framer Motion animations, creating an immersive shopping experience that reflects the brand's premium positioning and sustainability commitment.
